`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` is the public test fixture from

`Mihomo-Test.mmdb`, `Sing-GeoIP-Test.mmdb`, and `Mihomo-Invalid-Test.mmdb`
are synthetic fixtures generated by `generate_mmdb.py` (Python standard library
only). Run that script to reproduce them. They contain arbitrary test labels,
including multi-label IPv4/IPv6 records, single strings, duplicate and empty
labels, and deliberately invalid records. They contain no real geolocation
dataset. See the script for the exact prefixes and records.
